name: dist build output
check: git diff --quiet "${PSTACK_BASE:-HEAD~1}" "${PSTACK_HEAD:-HEAD}" -- src public package.json astro.config.mjs || (npm run build >/dev/null 2>&1 && git diff --quiet -- dist && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- dist)")
update: npm run build && git add dist .astro && git commit -m 'chore: rebuild dist'
